```python
    fast = head
    while fast and fast.next:
        slow = slow.next
        fast = fast.next.next
```

```python
def find_all_paths(graph, start, end):
    result = []
    def dfs(node, path):
        path.append(node)
        if node == end:
            result.append(path[:])
            path.pop()
            return
        for neighbor in graph.get(node, []):
            dfs(neighbor, path)
        path.pop()
    dfs(start, [])
    return result
```

```python
def find_intersection(l1, l2):
    seen = set()
    result = []
    s2 = set(l2)
    for item in l1:
        if item in s2 and item not in seen:
            seen.add(item)
            result.append(item)
    return result
```

```python
def count_bits(n):
    result = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        result[i] = result[i >> 1] + (i & 1)
    return result
```
